title: Headless TTW Finding the Garden of Eden (MQ08): from the player inside Vault 87 (MQ06 200) through Fawkes freed and the G.E.C.K. taken to the Enclave's capture at the vault's exit (stage 200, set when Raven Rock's holding cell scene sets MQ09 20)

actions.text: Joins where Picking Up the Trail (MQ06) ends: the player walking into Vault 87 sets MQ06 200 [observed], whose script sets MQ08 15 (find the G.E.C.K.). Set here directly so this chain runs alone.

Little Lamplight's back door (to Murder Pass): its terminal MQ06BackDoorTerminalRef says "The terminal is not powered." until MQ06.dbcomputeron is 2 (SCPT 0x0A003A17 [observed]). Joseph's line 0x0A003A0B ("Sure, if you want.") sets it to 1 and his package MQ06JosephActivateTerminal's end sets 2 [observed, Fallout3.esm]; the walk there is his AI (its end stands in).
Fawkes in his isolation cell: the cell terminal's fifth entry (Iso Room 05 Door Emergency Release) [observed] unlocks his door and sets stage 20.
Stand-in for the walk through the irradiated halls to the G.E.C.K. (the player fetches it, not Fawkes): the player goes to it and takes it; its OnAdd block [observed] sets stage 30.
The way out: the capture trigger at the vault's exit (MQ08CapturedScript) [observed] throws the flash grenade and puts the player at MQ08PlayerCaptureMarker.
Stand-in for the two Enclave guards walking to their places and Colonel Autumn walking up to the player (their AI packages; the package end scripts [observed] count the guards and set ConvoGo 2).

Stand-in for Colonel Autumn walking off with the G.E.C.K. (his MQ08ColonelAutumnExits package; its end script [observed] sets The American Dream (MQ09) stage 1, whose script moves the player to Raven Rock's holding cell).
Colonel Autumn questions the player in the holding cell (his package after the player container's EVP) [observed].

Stand-in for Colonel Autumn's walk out of the holding cell when the President calls him away (his package): he is put at MQ09AutumnLeaveMarker, where his script [observed] locks the cell door and lets the President's intercom talk to the player.

President Eden's intercom talks to the player (six SayTo lines, each SayToDone [observed] starting the next); after the last the stasis field drops and, 5 s later, MQ09 stage 20, whose script [observed] sets MQ08 200.
